verses: These are the sons of Yisra᾽el; Re᾽uven, Shim῾on, Levi, and Yehuda, Yissa­khar, and Zevulun,
Dan, Yosef, and Binyamin, Naftali, Gad and Asher.

The sons of Yehuda; ῾Er, and Onan, and Shela: which three were born to him of the daughter of Shua the Kena῾anite woman. And ῾Er, the firstborn of Yehuda, was evil in the sight of the Lord; and he slew him.
And Tamar his daughter in law bore him Pereż and Zeraĥ. All the sons of Yehuda were five.
The sons of Pereż; Ḥeżron, and Ḥamul.
And the sons of Zeraĥ; Zimri, and Etan, and Heman, and Kalkol, and Dare: five of them in all.
And the sons of Karmi; ῾Akhar, the troubler of Yisra᾽el, who transgressed in the devoted property.
And the sons of Etan; ῾Azarya.
And the sons of Ḥeżron, that were born to him; Yeraĥme᾽el, and Ram, and Keluvay.
And Ram begot ῾Amminadav; and ῾Amminadav begot Naĥshon, prince of the children of Yehuda;
and Naĥshon begot Salma, and Salma begot Bo῾az,
and Bo῾az begot ῾Oved, and ῾Oved begot Yishay,
and Ishay begot his firstborn Eli᾽av, and Avinadav the second, and Shim῾a the third,
Netan᾽el the fourth, Radday the fifth,
Ożem the sixth, David the seventh:
whose sisters were Żeruya, and Avigayil. And the sons of Żeruya; Avshay, and Yo᾽av, and Asa᾽el; three.
And Avigayil bore ῾Amasa: and the father of ῾Amasa was Yeter the Yishme῾elite.
And Kalev the son of Ḥeżron, begot children by ῾Azuva his wife, and by Yeri῾ot: her sons are these; Yesher, and Shovav, and Ardon.
And when ῾Azuva was dead, Kalev took to him Efrat, who bore him Ḥur.
And Ḥur begot Uri, and Uri begot Beżal᾽el.
And afterwards Ḥeżron went in to the daughter of Makhir the father of Gil῾ad, whom he married when he was sixty years old; and she bore him Seguv.
And Seguv begot Ya᾽ir, who had twenty three cities in the land of Gil῾ad.
And he took Geshur, and Aram, with Ḥavvot-ya᾽ir, from them, with Qenat, and its hamlets, sixty cities. All these belonged to the sons of Makhir the father of Gil῾ad.
And after Ḥeżron had died in Kalev-efrata, then Aviyya, Ḥeżron’s wife bore him Ashĥur the father of Teqoa.
And the sons of Yeraĥme᾽el the firstborn of Ḥeżron were, Ram the firstborn, and Buna, and Oren, and Ożem, and Aĥiyya.
Yeraĥme᾽el had also another wife, whose name was ῾Atara; she was the mother of Onam.
And the sons of Ram the firstborn of Yeraĥme᾽el were, Ma῾aż, and Yamin, and E῾qer.
And the sons of Onam were, Shammay, and Yada. And the sons of Shammay; Nadav, and Avishur.
And the name of the wife of Avishur was Aviĥayil, and she bore him Aĥban, and Molid.
And the sons of Nadav; Seled, and Appayim; but Seled died without children.
And the sons of Appayim; Yish῾i, And the sons of Yish῾i; Sheshan. And the children of Sheshan; Aĥlay.
And the sons of Yada the brother of Shammay; Yeter, and Yonatan: and Yeter died without children.
And the sons of Yonatan; Pelet, and Zaza. These were the sons of Yeraĥme᾽el.
Now Sheshan had no sons, but only daughters. And Sheshan had a slave, a Miżrian, whose name was Yarĥa.
And Sheshan gave his daughter to Yarĥa his slave to wife; and she bore him ῾Attay.
And ῾Attay begot Natan, and Natan begot Zavad.
and Zavad begot Eflal, and Eflal begot ῾Oved,
and ῾Oved begot Yehu, and Yehu begot ῾Azarya,
and ῾Azarya begot Ḥeleż, and Ḥeleż begot El῾asa,
and El῾asa begot Sismay, and Sismay begot Shallum,
and Shallum begot Yeqamya, and Yeqamya begot Elishama.
Now the sons of Kalev the brother of Yeraĥme᾽el were, Mesha his firstborn, who was the father of Zif; and the sons of Maresha the father of Ḥevron.
And the sons of Ḥevron; Qoraĥ, and Tappuaĥ, and Reqem, and Shema.
And Shema begot Raĥam, the father of Yorqe῾am: and Reqem begot Shammay.
And the son of Shammay was Ma῾on: and Ma῾on was the father of Bet-żur.
And ῾Efa, Kalev’s concubine, bore Ḥaran, and Moża, and Gazez: and Ḥaran begot Gazez.
And the sons of Yohday; Regem, and Yotam, and Geshan, and Pelet, and ῾Efa, and Sha῾af.
Ma῾akha, Kalev’s concubine, bore Shever, and Tirĥana.
She bore also Sha῾af the father of Madmanna, Sheva the father of Makhbena, and the father of Giv῾a: and the daughter of Kalev was ῾Akhsa.
These were the sons of Kalev the son of Ḥur, the firstborn of Efrata; Shoval the father of Qiryat-ye῾arim,
Salma the father of Bet-leĥem, Ḥaref the father of Bet-gader.
And Shoval the father of Qiryat-ye῾arim had sons; Haro᾽e, and half of the Menuĥot.
And the families of Qiryat-ye῾arim; the Yitri, and the Puti, and the Shumati, and the Mishra῾i; of them came the Żor῾ati, and the Eshta᾽uli.
The sons of Salma; Bet-leĥem, and the Netofati, ῾Atrot-bet-yo᾽av, and half the Manaĥti, and the Żor’i.
And the families of the scribes who dwelt at Ya῾beż; the Tir῾atim, the Shim῾atim, the Sukhatim. These are the Qinim who came of Ḥamat, the father of the house of Rekhav.
